desc:
🐒 Welcome to Be Monkey for Eggs

🥚 YOU EARN MONEY OFFLINE! 🥚

🥚 Sneak past dangerous guardians and steal their eggs as a MONKEY!
🏃 Escape before they catch you and bring the eggs back to your base!
🐣 Hatch your eggs to discover rare pets that earn you cash!
⚡ Train your speed and unlock new zones with better eggs!
👑 Collect the rarest pets and build the ultimate collection!

Can you steal the BEST egg? 🥚
